title: Overview · autonomous work
description: What needs attention, what changed today, and which agents are running. Home dashboard. A receipt is never a green outcome.

options.content:
**Overview · today in UTC · latest snapshot for live agents**

A receipt is never a green outcome. A truncated or unavailable source is a lower bound, not a zero. Range panels follow the time picker; UTC-day tiles say so.

panels.title: Needs attention
panels.description: Latest snapshot. Critical when anything needs attention. Links to Work on this page.

targets.expr: sum((ghostship_work_attention and on(source) (ghostship_work_source_up == 1)) and on() (time() - ghostship_work_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 180))

panels.title: Agents running
panels.description: Latest snapshot. In-flight agents and children.

targets.expr: sum((ghostship_work_active and on(source) (ghostship_work_source_up == 1)) and on() (time() - ghostship_work_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 180))

panels.title: Failed / blocked today
panels.description: UTC day. Failed, error, blocked, held or denied work. A receipt is never a green outcome.

targets.expr: stream:=autonomous-work | last 1 by (_time) partition by (source,kind,work_id) | filter status:in(failed,error,blocked,held,denied) event_today:1 | stats count() n

panels.title: Scheduled next 24h
panels.description: Latest snapshot. Enabled schedules with a next run. Not a guarantee they will fire.

targets.expr: stream:=autonomous-work | last 1 by (_time) partition by (source,kind,work_id) | filter kind:=schedule enabled:1 next_at:* | stats count() n

panels.title: Webhooks fired today
panels.description: UTC day, independent of the time picker. Webhook receipts, not delivery success.

targets.expr: stream:=autonomous-work | last 1 by (_time) partition by (source,kind,work_id) | filter kind:=webhook fired_today:1 | stats count() n

panels.title: PRs closed today
panels.description: Latest snapshot of close receipts, not a merge proof.

targets.expr: sum(ghostship_work_evidence_items{evidence="pr_closed"} and on(source) (ghostship_work_source_up == 1)) and on() (time() - ghostship_work_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 180)

panels.title: Work today
panels.description: UTC day, independent of the time picker. Count of distinct work items with event_today.

targets.expr: stream:=autonomous-work | last 1 by (_time) partition by (source,kind,work_id) | filter kind:!=coverage event_today:1 | stats count() n

panels.title: Snapshot age
panels.description: Latest snapshot age. Stale is not healthy.

targets.expr: time() - ghostship_work_snapshot_timestamp_seconds

panels.title: Host CPU
panels.description: Rolling 5-minute busy average across all cores. Opens Host.

targets.expr: 100 * (1 - avg(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle"}[5m])))

panels.title: Host memory
panels.description: Used share of total. Opens Host.

targets.expr: 100 * (1 - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes)

panels.title: Host disk used
panels.description: Root filesystem used share. Opens Host.

targets.expr: 100 * (1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{mountpoint="/"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{mountpoint="/"})

panels.title: Security alerts
panels.description: Firing alerts right now. Opens Security. Unavailable if the watchdog is stale.

targets.expr: (count(ALERTS{alertstate="firing"}) and on() (time() - ghostship_siem_watchdog_last_run_timestamp_seconds < 180))

panels.title: Deploys today
panels.description: Latest snapshot of deployment receipts. Unavailable when the series is absent.

targets.expr: sum((ghostship_work_evidence_items{evidence="deployment"} and on(source) (ghostship_work_source_up == 1)) and on() (time() - ghostship_work_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 180))

panels.title: CI failures
panels.description: Latest snapshot. Configured-check failures on the exact SHA, not a GitHub conclusion.

targets.expr: sum(ghostship_work_ci_failures and on(source) (ghostship_work_source_up == 1)) and on() (time() - ghostship_work_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 180)

panels.title: Ranking freshness
panels.description: Age of the AI usage collection. Opens Providers. Unavailable when the collector has not run.

targets.expr: time() - max(timestamp(ghostship_ai_collection_duration_seconds))

panels.title: Source gaps
panels.description: Latest snapshot. Sources that are down, not a zero of work.

targets.expr: (count(ghostship_work_source_up == 0) or vector(0)) and on() (time() - ghostship_work_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 180)

panels.title: Today's work  /  selected range
panels.description: Selected range (time picker). Durable state of runs, children, jobs, launches and reviews. Latest row per identity. Snapshot tables sit in collapsed rows.

targets.expr: stream:=autonomous-work kind:in(run,subagent,job,launch,workflow,review,request,continuation) | last 1 by (_time) partition by (source,kind,work_id,event_at,status) | sort by (event_at desc) limit 200 | fields _time,_msg,event_at,source,kind,work_id,status,provider,evidence,thread_url,github_url

panels.title: Webhook fires  /  selected range
panels.description: Webhooks that fired inside the selected time range, with their receipt outcome. The datasource sends the picker's start and end, so the window is exact.

targets.expr: stream:=autonomous-work kind:=webhook | last 1 by (_time) partition by (source,kind,work_id) | sort by (fired_at desc) limit 200 | fields _time,_msg,fired_at,event_at,source,work_id,event,action,evidence,status,github_url

panels.title: Running now  /  every running agent, child and ordinary
panels.description: Latest snapshot. Every running agent and sub-agent: provider, model, branch, state, parent, T3 thread. Branch and model are private log fields, never metric labels.

targets.expr: stream:=autonomous-work _time:3m source:=t3_agents kind:=agent | last 1 by (_time) partition by (source,kind,work_id) | sort by (status, event_at desc) limit 1000 | fields _time,_msg,event_at,status,provider,model,branch,work_id,project_id,thread_url,parent_url

panels.title: Work detail · next up, attention, queues
Next up  /  schedules & timer initiators
panels.description: Enabled schedules with a next run, plus host systemd timers. The enable flag, the next run, the last run and the last result are separate facts. Current state from the last collector snapshot (one-minute poll); not a range total.

targets.expr: stream:=autonomous-work _time:3m kind:=schedule | last 1 by (_time) partition by (source,kind,work_id) | filter enabled:1 next_at:* | sort by (next_at) limit 200 | fields _msg,_time,source,unit,trigger,enabled,next_at,event_at,status,last_status,thread_url,github_url

panels.title: Attention  /  failures & held work
panels.description: Latest state per work item in a failure, blocked or held state. Current state from the last collector snapshot (one-minute poll); not a range total.

targets.expr: stream:=autonomous-work _time:3m | last 1 by (_time) partition by (source,kind,work_id) | filter status:in(failed,error,blocked,held,denied,timeout,uncertain,upstream_blocked,unavailable,partial,conflict,dispatch_failed,rejected_signature,rate_limited) | sort by (event_at desc) limit 200 | fields _time,_msg,event_at,source,kind,work_id,status,thread_url,github_url

panels.title: Queues & jobs  /  explicit waiting and background work
panels.description: Runtime queues, launch workflows and pending native requests. Agents and their runs are in the agent table above; a recorded state is not process liveness. Current state from the last collector snapshot (one-minute poll); not a range total.

targets.expr: stream:=autonomous-work _time:3m | last 1 by (_time) partition by (source,kind,work_id) | filter kind:in(job,workflow,request) status:in(pending,queued,running,starting,in_progress,waiting,requested,native-running,preparing,prepared,executing,blocked) | sort by (event_at desc) limit 200 | fields _msg,_time,event_at,source,kind,work_id,status,provider,evidence,thread_url,github_url

panels.title: Agents  /  last 24 h terminal history
panels.description: The windowed terminal history of the same threads: completed, failed, cancelled or idle. Active work is never in this window. Latest snapshot of terminal history.

targets.expr: stream:=autonomous-work _time:24h source:=t3_agent_history kind:=agent | last 1 by (_time) partition by (source,kind,work_id) | sort by (event_at desc) limit 200 | fields _time,_msg,event_at,status,provider,model,branch,work_id,project_id,thread_url,parent_url

panels.title: Work detail · coverage, CI proof, schedules, source health
Coverage  /  freshness, limits & read cost
panels.description: Per-source coverage of the last snapshot. A gap is a missing source, not an empty result; objective completion has no source today. Current state from the last collector snapshot (one-minute poll); not a range total.

targets.expr: stream:=autonomous-work _time:3m kind:=coverage | last 1 by (_time) partition by (source,kind,work_id) | sort by (source) limit 200 | fields _msg,_time,source,coverage,reason,rows,limited,duration_seconds

panels.title: CI proof  /  configured checks on the exact SHA
panels.description: The coordinator CI proof of each pull request: the outcome, the merge flag, the required check count and the failing check count, bound to the exact revision. It proves configured checks on that revision, nothing else. Current state from the last collector snapshot (one-minute poll); not a range total.

targets.expr: stream:=autonomous-work _time:3m kind:=ci_proof | last 1 by (_time) partition by (source,kind,work_id) | sort by (event_at desc) limit 200 | fields _time,_msg,event_at,outcome,merged,required_checks,failed_checks,revision,github_url,thread_url

panels.title: Schedule inventory  /  enabled, disabled & timers
panels.description: Every known schedule, including disabled ones and host timers, with its next run, last run and last result. Current state from the last collector snapshot (one-minute poll); not a range total.

targets.expr: stream:=autonomous-work _time:3m kind:=schedule | last 1 by (_time) partition by (source,kind,work_id) | sort by (source,unit,work_id) limit 200 | fields _msg,_time,source,unit,trigger,enabled,next_at,event_at,status,last_status,thread_url,github_url

panels.title: Source health  /  last successful read age
panels.description: Seconds since each source last read successfully. A source that never succeeded has no row here; the snapshot age above catches a collector failure. Current state from the last collector snapshot (one-minute poll); not a range total.

targets.expr: time() - last_over_time(ghostship_work_source_last_success_seconds[24h])

panels.title: Work detail · projects, threads, handoffs (receipts, not outcomes)
Projects  /  native inventory
panels.description: Native T3 projects, including projects without agent activity. At most 200 rows per source: a truncated source is a lower bound, not a complete inventory. Current state from the last collector snapshot (one-minute poll); not a range total.

targets.expr: stream:=autonomous-work _time:3m kind:=project | last 1 by (_time) partition by (source,kind,work_id) | sort by (project_id) limit 200 | fields _msg,_time,project_id,thread_count,event_at,coverage

panels.title: Threads  /  manual, ordinary & agent work
panels.description: Ordinary and agent threads across every project, with the latest recorded state. At most 200 rows per source: a truncated source is a lower bound, not a complete inventory. Current state from the last collector snapshot (one-minute poll); not a range total.

targets.expr: stream:=autonomous-work _time:3m kind:=thread | last 1 by (_time) partition by (source,kind,work_id) | sort by (event_at desc) limit 200 | fields _msg,_time,event_at,project_id,work_id,status,provider,evidence,thread_url,github_url

panels.title: Handoffs & evidence  /  reviews, artifacts & continuations
panels.description: Review reports, provider routing, model continuations and every open pull request artifact. A review report is a model report; a reserved slot or an accepted switch is a receipt, not objective completion. Current state from the last collector snapshot (one-minute poll); not a range total.

targets.expr: stream:=autonomous-work _time:3m kind:in(review,thread,artifact,request,routing,continuation) | last 1 by (_time) partition by (source,kind,work_id) | filter (kind:in(review,request,routing,continuation) OR github_url:*) | sort by (event_at desc) limit 200 | fields _time,_msg,event_at,source,kind,work_id,status,evidence,action,occupied,next_at,provider,switch_accepted,message_accepted,native_run_count,executing_count,route_state,primary_quota,route_reason,fallback,thread_url,github_url

panels.title: Model reports
panels.description: Latest snapshot. Model-report receipts, never an approval.

targets.expr: sum(ghostship_work_evidence_items{evidence="model_report"} and on(source) (ghostship_work_source_up == 1)) and on() (time() - ghostship_work_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 180)

panels.title: CI proofs
panels.description: Latest snapshot. Coordinator CI proof receipts on the exact SHA.

targets.expr: sum(ghostship_work_evidence_items{evidence="ci_proof"} and on(source) (ghostship_work_source_up == 1)) and on() (time() - ghostship_work_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 180)

panels.title: Review receipts
panels.description: Latest snapshot. Review receipts, never a green outcome.

targets.expr: sum(ghostship_work_evidence_items{evidence="review"} and on(source) (ghostship_work_source_up == 1)) and on() (time() - ghostship_work_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 180)

panels.title: Sources capped

targets.expr: (count(ghostship_work_source_limited == 1) or vector(0)) and on() (time() - ghostship_work_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 180)

panels.description: Latest snapshot. Sources that hit their row cap.
